title: N-body next-to-leading order gravitational spin-orbit interaction via effective field theory
summary: Using the post-Newtonian effective field theory (PN-EFT) formalism for spinning gravitating bodies, we derive the next-to-leading-order (NLO) spin-orbit potential and Hamiltonian for a system of N spinning bodies in general relativity. This extends the EFT treatment of the binary case to arbitrary N. We present two derivations: one in the generalized canonical gauge, and one based on the covariant spin supplementary condition (SSC), followed by a noncanonical transformation to canonical variables.
